scope: Object names, required identities, prohibited ambiguities and reconstruction tests are the registered claim-linkage text. 'artifacts' lists, for this repository, the run-archive files (paths relative to a run directory) or repository paths that carry the identity; 'checks' lists the make targets that perform the reconstruction test. The generator verifies that every artifact is written by the released runtime (present in a bundled example run) or exists in the repository, and that every check is a Makefile target.

plant.identity: architecture, preprocessing, external-data status, split and hashes

models.identity: schema, folds, propensities, architecture, calibration and hash

comparator.identity: family, nested selections, frequencies and prediction hash
comparator.ambiguity: favourable comparator chosen on evaluation units
comparator.test: repeat comparator reconstruction in every resample

selected.identity: candidate ledger, confirmation contrast, resources, origins and hashes

executable.identity: g_input, support strata, recovery priorities and hash

deployed.identity: admission arithmetic, branch ID and prediction hash

displays.identity: source data, generator, environment and commit
